meta.note: CASA says a drone over 250 g must not fly within 5.5 km (3 nautical miles) of a controlled airport (one with a control tower), measured from the runway centreline, nor in the runway's approach and departure paths, which reach 7 km. Near an airport without a tower you may fly, but must move away from any crewed aircraft. This circle is drawn at every airport in the open data, so it shows more places than the rule covers. Check a CASA-verified drone safety app.
